name: IndexLinks API
description: IndexLinks guarantees every new and updated page is indexed by Google and visible in AI search (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) within 24 hours, or we retry it free. We run a private network of high-authority, topical properties that search and AI crawlers hit several times an hour, plus IndexNow and our sitemap autopilot, and show a verified receipt for every page.
